name: Roland JD-Xi
description: Roland JD-Xi crossover synthesizer: two SuperNATURAL digital parts, an analog part and a drum part, with the program they sit in. Every block of the temporary (edit-buffer) area in the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: JD-Xi MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, May 1, 2015)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from JD-Xi_MIDI_Imple_e01_W.pdf (sha256 aa516bd31d972c3a7cbfe4f952712f09c9a8856a2c1d854e2f8b7c67ed6bb4a3). Model ID 00 00 00 0E, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Digital parts 1 and 2 are the same SuperNATURAL tone layout at 19 00 00 00 and 19 20 00 00; the analog part is at 19 42 00 00; the drum kit at 19 70 00 00, one partial per key from 36 to 72.
